labels.look: White heavy display caps on black, arrows framing the name, pill CTA
labels.learn: 'INTRODUCING →FACTION←': the launch announcement itself is the specimen

labels.variantDefinition: Block captured empty or mid-load (video not started, loader, lazy content); not analysable from the still
labels.learn: Check the scroll video for what loads here

labels.variantDefinition: Software-product landing pattern: headline, tagline, paragraph, primary and secondary buttons
labels.look: Dark slate, pastel gradient mono wordmark, italic tagline, two buttons
labels.ux: 'Learn more' and 'Try it now' CTAs; GitHub and Playground in nav
labels.learn: Coding fonts borrow dev-tool landing conventions; 'Try it now' leads into a playground

labels.variantDefinition: The hero's main content is a specimen the visitor manipulates (weight, size, colour, axes) right away
labels.look: Big red 'G' and weight columns (Hairline 50 → Medium 500, 276px, #ff3b4e); privacy modal covers the capture
labels.ux: Columns expose weight, size and colour values; Buy and Free download links
labels.learn: Print the live values (weight, px, hex) next to the specimen, like design-tool inspector labels

labels.look: Landscape photo (blue sky, savanna), thin white name, letterspaced tagline
labels.learn: A photo hero works for a neutral DIN but says little about the design itself

labels.variantDefinition: A grid of video or animated tiles, each a glyph or word in motion, forming the opening wall
labels.look: Monochrome grid of film stills: numerals, timecodes, letters over smoke, clouds and light
labels.learn: The type's origin (film subtitling) becomes the medium: the specimen is a film strip

labels.variantDefinition: An illustrated scene or characters (mascots, faces, objects) staged with the type; illustration carries the tone
labels.look: Saturated blue, yellow outlined name, pink smiling moon face, 'SCROLL' with arrows; Try and Buy tabs on rails
labels.learn: A mascot built from the type's own roundness sets the tone faster than any copy

labels.look: Giant pink MCNK, then technical-diagram collage: mono/semi/poly schematics, circles of letters
labels.learn: Engineering diagrams explain the mono/semi/poly widths visually before any text

labels.look: Black, stacked SKWAR repetitions fading into a pyramid, white mono intro
labels.ux: Weight and width sliders plus a SHUFFLE button right in the hero
labels.learn: Put the two axes right under the name: the hero is the tester
